== Course of events ==

The Scarecrow's mishap occurred while the travelers were crossing a river on a raft that the Tin Woodman had built, after the group had made its way out of the meadow of scarlet poppies. As the raft moved across the water, the Scarecrow's pole caught fast in the riverbed. Unable to free it in time, the Scarecrow was left stranded on the pole in the middle of the river as the raft, carrying his companions, drifted onward without him.
